title: glosa hypothesis selection
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements templates/knowledge/hypothesis_selection.yaml (S14, founder addition HANDOFF 35d): after n LRS runs, a HUMAN compares candidate hypotheses and selects which carry forward into the genre router -- non-delegable (matches claim_card.responsible: human). An AI route may PROPOSE the comparison table, never make the selection. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

session_id.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §7 item 7 (schema.retention-direction-field.session-grouping-key, SA-2): the session in which `decided_at` happened, joined against schema/blackbox_note.schema.json's own `session_id`. Wiring this in is the founder's own recommended default once session.boundary-blackbox-note (SA-1) lands in the same pass -- founder ratification of §7 item 7 itself is still PENDING; until ratified, `_session_span_count` (kernel/glosa_kernel.py) only counts sessions it can actually see named here and in `chooser_reaffirmations[]`, never fabricating a count. Additive/optional.

chooser_reaffirmations.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §2.1 (schema.retention-direction-field, SA-2): a session reopening a previously-chosen hypothesis must have the HUMAN (not persistence) reaffirm it -- one entry per session the selection was revisited in. Additive/optional; used by kernel rule NC-77 to count session span.

retained_direction.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §4 (NC-77, Family J, 'Retention != Direction'): persistence/retention of a chosen hypothesis across >=2 sessions is never by itself evidence it is expansion rather than tunnel. Default 'unknown'; a non-unknown value on a chosen row spanning >=2 sessions requires a resolvable `direction_evidence_relation` (kernel-enforced, see `_retained_direction_error`) -- schema only carries the enum/default, not the cross-field force. D-RETENTION-DIRECTION.

direction_evidence_relation.description: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §4 NC-77's own exception clause: 'a row whose evidence_relation resolves to an existing checker/falsifier verdict -- that verdict's own sign stands'. Additive/optional; null/absent means no independent-check artifact is linked, which is exactly the condition that forces `retained_direction` to stay 'unknown' on a >=2-session chosen row.

allOf.description: A chosen hypothesis's routed genre must be one its own genre_fit.candidate_genres actually listed (S14 §11 'not a suggestion') -- schema checks presence of the field, not the cross-array match itself (kernel-enforced).
